quest.title: A Tour of Wonders
quest.description: Onnea from Mondstadt seems to have something to tell you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Invokation Coupons x50, Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

dialogues.speaker: Onnea
dialogues.text: Please wait! Are you also here for the King of Invokations Grand Prix?

dialogues.speaker: Onnea
dialogues.text: If you have a minute, I'd like to tell you a little about this event hosted by the Adventurers' Guild called "A Tour of Wonders."

response.speaker: Onnea
response.text: Thank you! Then I'll go ahead and introduce the basics of this event.

response.speaker: Onnea
response.text: Simply put, the Adventurers' Guild has placed multiple Scenic Checkpoints in various locations across Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Onnea
response.text: All you have to do is find these Scenic Checkpoints and mark your Sightseeing Handbook with the commemorative stamps at each location.

response.speaker: Onnea
response.text: The challenge will be considered completed once you find every Scenic Checkpoint and collect all the stamps.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sure sounds like something the Adventurers' Guild would host.

response.speaker: Onnea
response.text: Hehe... We put a lot of thought into the placement of these Scenic Checkpoints.

response.speaker: Onnea
response.text: However... some of them are located in remote areas, and I can't guarantee they're entirely clear of monsters.

response.speaker: Onnea
response.text: But I'm sure that dealing with those monsters would be a walk in the park for someone as experienced as you.

response.speaker: Onnea
response.text: And that's all from me! Here's your Sightseeing Handbook. Have fun!
